note: Old-fashioned wooded campground on a terrace above spring-fed Muskellunge Lake, north of Tomahawk; the operator says most sites overlook the lake, through the trees. Sandy beach, five fishing piers, and canoe, paddleboat and boat rentals. Passport America discount. --Claude
summary: Operator rates/about pages, RV Life, Google 4.4 (76) and imagery read. $50/day before tax (water + 20/30A, 4 people): passes the price gate at exactly $50 (no gateway within 40 km, not a Good Sam Park). Daily, holiday and weekly rates only, no seasonal rate posted. Lakeview KEPT: camper sites sit 50-100 m up from the shore under continuous canopy. Pin moves ~390 m to the campsites. Sewer not supported by the current site.
flags: Price gate: $50 a day before 5.5% tax for an ordinary water/electric site = exactly the US$50 line, so it passes (not over). No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py); Passport America discount posted, not a Good Sam Park. Reviewer note: any increase tips it over.

Long-stay: rates posted are daily, holiday (3 nights) and weekly only; no seasonal or monthly rate and no lots for sale. Not a long-stay park on the evidence read; nightly share not measurable (no site list). 'Reservations - Call for availability' is the phone booking line, not a seasonal-preference statement.

Lakeview KEPT (no --AWH value): the operator says 'Most of our sites overlook the lake'. Esri imagery shows camper pads on the slope at about 45.5365-45.5370,-89.6895 to -89.6865, 50-100 m up from the water under continuous tree canopy; the only open ground at the shore is the beach/pier area (45.5348,-89.6884). No site numbers published. View at most; no upgrade.
PIN MOVE ~390 m: stored 45.5386,-89.6927 sits in woods near the road NW of the campground; target 45.5366,-89.6882, the camper area above the beach (Google pin 45.53672,-89.68882).
